question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 F 组：突尼斯 vs 荷兰（90 分钟三路赛果）
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group F: Tunisia vs Netherlands (90-minute three-way result)
one_liner_cn: 荷兰 Elo 高出 320 分且突尼斯热身赛 0-5 崩盘，蒂姆贝尔缺阵影响有限，荷兰胜率约 73%。
one_liner_en: With a 320-point Elo edge and Tunisia's 0-5 warm-up collapse, Timber's absence barely dents a ~73% Dutch win probability.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差 320 分：荷兰 1948（第 8）对突尼斯 1628（第 58），实力差距悬殊。
key_reasons.en: 320-point Elo gap: Netherlands 1948 (8th) vs Tunisia 1628 (58th) — a heavily lopsided matchup.

key_reasons.cn: 突尼斯最后一场热身 0-5 惨败比利时，主帅 Lamouchi 公开道歉，且其 2026 年初才接手球队。
key_reasons.en: Tunisia lost their final warm-up 0-5 to Belgium, prompting a public apology from coach Lamouchi, who only took over in early 2026.

key_reasons.cn: 荷兰后卫蒂姆贝尔因腹股沟伤势无缘世界杯，Geertruida 补招，防线深度小幅受损。
key_reasons.en: Netherlands defender Jurrien Timber misses the World Cup with a groin injury; Geertruida called up, modestly thinning defensive depth.

method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, no host bonus) gave 11.0/19.4/69.6; bounded evidence adjustment of 6pp total (cap ±8pp) shifted to 9.0/18.4/72.6. Independent of all betting/prediction-market prices.
